description: This HTML file contains embedded JavaScript for creating an interactive UI example demonstrating image button selections, including different states (normal, disabled, selected) and types (checkbox, radio). It utilizes the Isomorphic SmartClient library to create UI components and handle events.

classes.name: Label
classes.description: UI component used for displaying text labels on the interface.

classes.name: ImgButton
classes.description: UI component representing an image-based button with different states and functionalities (normal, selected, disabled).

methods.name: showClicked
methods.description: Function called when any image button is clicked; updates the display to indicate which button was clicked.
